xrefdescription.para: T4.4.1f: Error Context Preservation Across Fallback

detaileddescription.para: Verify that error context is preserved when falling back to degraded path
Verify context manager correctly handles multiple turns and complex eviction
Verify that failure_threshold consecutive failures transition the circuit breaker from CLOSED to OPEN.
Verify that a successful request in HALF_OPEN state transitions the circuit breaker back to CLOSED.
Verify that a failing probe in HALF_OPEN state transitions the circuit breaker back to OPEN.
Verify that circuit breakers for different operation types are independent — failure in one does not affect others.
Verify that in HALF_OPEN state, only half_open_max_requests calls are permitted before the decision is made.
Verify that forceReset() transitions any state back to CLOSED and clears failure counters, allowing immediate resumption of traffic.
Multiple threads simultaneously add turns; verify no data races, token count never exceeds limit, and size is consistent.
Multiple threads drive the circuit breaker simultaneously; verify state transitions are consistent (no invalid states).
Two threads race to exhaust the token budget; verify exactly one wins and the limit is not exceeded.
Verify that concurrent evictions under a tight token budget always maintain structural integrity.
Concurrent readers and writers; verify size() never exceeds what would be structurally valid.
Two threads alternately lock two independent contexts in opposite order; verify no deadlock occurs within a bounded time.
Multiple threads create AQLErrorContext objects concurrently; verify no corruption in their independent states.
High-contention stress test: 16 threads × 50 turns each against a single context with a tight token budget.
Verify that an unavailable infer provider returns a structured error with ProviderUnavailable category, not a crash or silent failure.
Verify that a RAG provider timeout causes the system to fall back gracefully to zero-shot translation without few-shot context.
Verify that an embedding provider failure causes the system to fall back to keyword-based similarity (Jaccard) without crashing.
When multiple providers fail simultaneously, verify that the error priority order is: Infer > RAG > Embed (blocking feature first).
Verify that after N failures the provider correctly reports success again when the underlying service recovers (FailAfterN + reset).
Verify that sustained provider failures trigger the circuit breaker to open, preventing further calls until reset.
Verify that RAG provider failure correctly falls back to the static template library for few-shot examples.
Verify that error messages contain accurate, actionable diagnostic information that would help operators triage production issues.
Verify that a null (empty) schema context is explicitly rejected with fail-closed semantics and a structured error category.
Verify that an empty AQL query is also rejected with a clear diagnostic hint.
Verify that referencing an unregistered collection returns MissingFieldMetadata with the collection name in the error context.
Verify that type mismatch between a field definition and a filter expression is detected and reported with the TypeMismatch category.
Verify that schema validation handles a large number of fields without performance degradation (basic wall-clock smoke test).
Verify that AQLErrorContext produced during schema validation contains actionable diagnostic hints in its formatted log output.
Verify behavior when a turn exactly fills the remaining token budget: no eviction should occur, the turn must be accepted.
Verify that a single turn larger than the entire budget is rejected with a ContextBoundExceeded error (fail-closed).
Verify that when token budget is exceeded, the oldest turn is evicted first (FIFO eviction order).
Verify that when max_turns is reached, the oldest turn is evicted even if the token budget is not yet exhausted.
Verify that the token counting formula is applied consistently: currentTokens() == sum of individual turn token counts.
Verify edge conditions: zero budget, single-token budget, empty strings, and one-char strings.
